title: rs_verdict_result_response
description: Structured output for the readiness-score verdict judge. Submit the final aggregate readiness score and the top 3 recommendations that would most raise it.

score.description: The final 0-100 aggregate readiness score. This is the number persisted to the work item's agent plan, so it must be the CAPPED value when a gate fired, never aggregate_uncapped. Round to the nearest integer.

feedback.description: Exactly 3 recommendations that would most raise the score, most impactful first. When a gate fired, the blocking amendment must be the first item.

recommendation.description: One concrete, actionable amendment to the plan, <=140 chars. Name what to change, not merely that something is wrong.

impact.description: 'blocking' when the plan should not be handed off until this is addressed; 'non-blocking' when it improves the plan without gating hand-off.
